steps.title: Send the 3 stakeholder replies
steps.detail: Check the agent drafts, adjust the tone, and send each reply in its original thread.
steps.why: Messages go out in your name.

steps.title: Review + post weekly status
steps.detail: The project update is overdue. Check the agent draft, then post it.
steps.why: A status claim to leadership in your name.

steps.title: Plan → apply the infra change
steps.detail: Run the plan for production. It must add one resource and change nothing else; if not, stop. Then apply.
steps.why: A production infra change needs your credentials.

steps.title: VPN + secrets sign-in
steps.detail: Open the VPN and a secrets-manager session so the checks agent can read config in each environment.

steps.title: Submit review on PR B
steps.detail: Read the agent findings on the rate-limit change. Submit your review.
steps.why: A review is your judgment and carries your name.

steps.title: OK the PR A push, ask re-review
steps.detail: Read the agent’s diff for the requested changes. Approve the push and ask the reviewer to look again.
steps.why: Pushing to a reviewed PR and pinging the reviewer.

steps.title: Send follow-ups
steps.detail: Send the prepared follow-ups to each stakeholder who replied.
steps.why: Messages go out in your name.

steps.title: Approve release → retire old service
steps.detail: After the soak report: switch traffic to the new service, then turn off the old one.

steps.title: Ask Ops to approve the deploy job
steps.detail: The production deploy job waits for an Ops approval.
steps.why: A request to another team in your name.

steps.title: Ask for review on PR C
steps.detail: No reviewer is requested yet. Ask a teammate once CI is green.

steps.title: Go: merge PR C + staging deploy
steps.detail: Once review and checks are green, tell the build agent to merge and deploy to staging.
steps.why: Merges and deploys need your go-ahead.

steps.title: Authorize prod dry-run
steps.detail: Confirm infra, config and staging checks are green. The dry-run writes nothing.

steps.title: Ops approves the deploy job
steps.detail: Ops owns the production approval.

steps.title: Vendor ships their side
steps.detail: The vendor deploys their change. Check one new event afterwards.

steps.title: Teammate reviews PR C
steps.detail: Human review of the release workflow.

steps.title: Reviewer re-reviews PR A
steps.detail: Clears “changes requested” so PR A can merge.

steps.title: Stakeholders reply
steps.detail: Some are out today. Expect the rest of the replies tomorrow.

steps.title: Stakeholders confirm results
steps.detail: They confirm the new output matches. Rollback: switch traffic back to the old service.

steps.title: Draft the 3 stakeholder replies
steps.detail: Pull the context from each thread and draft one reply per stakeholder. Do not send.

steps.title: Draft weekly status
steps.detail: Build it from this week’s merged work. Flag the release date risk.

steps.title: Prepare follow-ups
steps.detail: List who replied and draft one follow-up each. Do not send.

steps.title: Fix CI failure on PR C
steps.detail: Read the failed job, make a targeted fix, push, and report the new check result.

steps.title: Merge PR C · deploy to staging
steps.detail: After your go-ahead: merge, run the staging deploy, and watch it.

steps.title: Verify staging end to end
steps.detail: Confirm the scheduled job runs and writes dry-run output in staging.

steps.title: Start prod dry-run
steps.detail: Deploy to production in dry-run mode after your approval. Check the first run’s output.

steps.title: Check secrets + config in each env
steps.detail: Confirm each required secret exists in staging and production. Report presence only. Never print values.

steps.title: Compare new vs old output
steps.detail: Every old result needs a matching new one. Explain any extras.

steps.title: PR A: changes, rebase, test
steps.detail: Work through the requested changes, rebase, and run the tests. Prepare the diff for your review; do not push.

steps.title: PR B: draft review findings
steps.detail: Review limits, failure modes and tests. Draft findings for you.
